title: Tha Alpha Politocal Male
title_zh: 阿尔法政治男性
authors: Marta Reynal-Querol, Mario Francesco Carillo, Marta Reynal-Querol; Mario Francesco Carillo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-11 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The alpha male, associated with traditional masculinity features such as competitiveness, assertiveness, and risk tolerance, embodies a biologically grounded dimension of personality. We construct a novel dataset of political leaders' masculinity---measured by facial width-to-height ratio, an established biological marker for traditional masculine behavior driven by testosterone---for more than 2,000 national leaders across 184 countries over 150 years. Leaders’ masculinity has increased over the past 70 years in both democracies and autocracies, across rich and poor countries, and across all regions. Benchmarking against Olympic athletes, Wikipedia-notable individuals, and U.S.\ population data, we document that political leaders exhibit systematically higher masculinity than other groups, in both democracies and autocracies. Leaders' masculinity surges during periods of geopolitical uncertainty, such as the World Wars, the Cold War, and recent decades. Two empirical applications show that masculine leaders are related to democratic change and international war, and these links depend on the institutional environment.
abstract_zh: 阿尔法男性特质，如竞争性、自信和风险承受力，与传统男性气质相关，体现了一种基于生物基础的人格维度。我们构建了一个涵盖150年间184个国家2000多位国家领导人的新型数据集，以面部宽高比（一种由睾酮驱动的传统男性行为的既定生物标志）衡量其男性气质。过去70年间，无论是民主国家还是专制国家、富裕国家还是贫穷国家、以及所有地区，领导人的男性气质均有所上升。通过与奥运运动员、维基百科知名人士及美国人口数据对比，我们发现政治领导人的男性气质在民主和专制国家中均系统性高于其他群体。在地缘政治不确定时期（如两次世界大战、冷战及近几十年），领导人的男性气质显著激增。两项实证研究表明，男性气质与民主变革及国际战争存在关联，且这种关联取决于制度环境。

title: Household Behavior Below the Zero Lower Bound
title_zh: 零下限以下的家户行为
authors: Andersen, Asger Lau, Johannesen, Niels, Petersen, Jens Brøndum, Settele, Sonja, Wohlfart, Johannes
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How do households respond when deposit rates drop below zero? Using administrative micro data and exploiting cross-bank variation in interest rate policies, we study a major episode of negative deposit rates in Denmark affecting two thirds of household deposits. We find that households strongly reduced deposit balances when exposed to negative deposit rates, allocating funds to stock portfolios and consumption. In a large-scale survey, we document important roles for loss aversion, perceived unfairness, intertemporal substitution and return considerations in driving these responses. Our findings suggest that monetary policy can have strong consumption effects in negative territory.
abstract_zh: 当存款利率降至负值时，家庭会如何应对？利用行政微观数据并借助银行间利率政策的差异，我们研究了丹麦一次影响三分之二家庭存款的重大负存款利率事件。研究发现，当家庭面临负存款利率时，会大幅减少存款余额，将资金配置至股票投资组合和消费领域。通过大规模调查，我们证实损失厌恶、感知不公、跨期替代及收益考量在驱动这些行为中发挥重要作用。研究结果表明，货币政策在负利率区间可能对消费产生显著影响。

title: The Growth Effects of Natural Disasters: Evidence From A Novel Global Dataset Over 1970-2023
title_zh: 自然灾害的增长效应：基于1970-2023年全球新数据集的经验证据
authors: Ha Nguyen & Mr. Mehdi Raissi & Mr. Bruno Versailles & Alice Tianbo Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We construct standardized climate anomalies from daily observations and carefully calibrate physical thresholds to identify storms, floods, droughts, heatwaves, and cold snaps across 196 countries over the period 1970–2023. Using a local projections framework, we estimate the contemporaneous and 2-year effects of each disaster type and collectively on real GDP growth. We find that storms, floods, droughts, and heatwaves significantly reduce growth on impact (by roughly 0.1–0.2 percentage points on average), with the largest effects observed in emerging markets and developing economies. Cold spells have no statistically significant impacts. Our estimations also indicate that the initial drop in GDP growth is often not fully offset by a quick rebound, leaving GDP below the pre-disaster trend in the subsequent two years. Severe disasters impose far larger costs. Catastrophic floods can lower growth by up to 3 percentage points (with once-in-100-year storms or heatwaves reducing growth by ~0.5pp and extreme droughts by ~1pp). By combining the estimated global coefficients with each country’s own disaster intensity, we translate the aggregate results into localized growth effects and cross-check them against estimates from a dynamic heterogenous panel model. Finally, rolling-window estimates indicate that the contemporaneous growth impact of storms and heatwaves has attenuated in recent decades, whereas droughts have become increasingly damaging, reflecting divergent adaptation or even maladaptation and vulnerability trends over time.
abstract_zh: 我们基于每日观测数据构建了标准化的气候异常指标，并仔细校准了物理阈值，以识别1970-2023年间196个国家的风暴、洪水、干旱、热浪和寒潮事件。通过局部投影框架，我们估算了每种灾害类型及其综合对实际GDP增长的当期影响和两年期效应。研究发现，风暴、洪水、干旱和热浪在冲击当期显著抑制经济增长（平均约0.1-0.2个百分点），其中新兴市场和发展中经济体的影响最为显著。寒潮则未呈现统计显著影响。我们的估算还表明，GDP增长的初始下降通常无法通过快速反弹完全弥补，导致后续两年GDP仍低于灾前趋势水平。严重灾害造成的成本远高于平均水平：灾难性洪水可使增长率下降高达3个百分点（百年一遇的风暴或热浪约降低0.5个百分点，极端干旱约降低1个百分点）。通过将全球估计系数与各国自身灾害强度相结合，我们将汇总结果转化为局部增长效应，并与动态异质性面板模型的估计结果进行交叉验证。最后，滚动窗口估计表明，近几十年来风暴和热浪的当期增长冲击有所减弱，而干旱的破坏性持续增强，这反映了随时间推移出现的适应性分化乃至适应不良与脆弱性趋势的演变。

title: Hunting for Hollanders: The community responsibility system, trade sanctions, and public debt in the late‐medieval Low Countries
title_zh: 追寻荷兰人：中世纪晚期低地国家的社区责任体系、贸易制裁与公共债务
authors: Jaco Zuijderduijn
abstract: Abstract To persuade creditors to lend, cities in the Low Countries relied on a community responsibility system that made all citizens personally liable for public debt. This exposed itinerant citizens to significant risks: their merchandise could be confiscated by creditors, and they could even be imprisoned for debt. Although it is usually difficult to assess how such sanctions were enforced in practice, this study examines a unique account of a group of creditors actively pursuing repayment. Their principal debt collector was a monk of the Carthusian order who travelled tirelessly throughout the Lower Rhine region in search of inhabitants of the county of Holland. This monk‐turned‐bounty‐hunter primarily targeted merchants and their goods but also sought to seize financial instruments and real estate owned by Hollanders. Whilst existing literature emphasizes reputation‐based mechanisms to explain polities’ access to credit, this evidence suggests that sanction‐based mechanisms were equally important: reprisals proved effective in recovering debts. Considering that the community responsibility system exposed merchants to sanctions, its survival into the early modern period is quite striking. I argue that the creation of public debt secured political and economic privileges that cities valued more highly than the safety of their merchants.
